narrative.offerRewardText: I knew you'd come through, adventurer! Here's your reward.
narrative.requestItemsText: You've truly exceeded all my expectations, adventurer. You've been taking on opponents that Huum and I would think long and hard before engaging.At this point the best I can do is to continue rewarding your efforts in the fight against the Twilight's Hammer and their overlords.Bring me more abyssal scepters and I'll do my best to give you a suitable reward.
